source.title: Random Schrödinger operators: Recent results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL. The zbMATH API record for document 3935567 returned metadata for Werner Kirsch and Fabio Martinelli, identifier 0584.35023, source "Trends and developments in the eighties, Bielefeld Encounters Math. Phys. 4 and 5, 289-308 (1985)", and no full-text links.

Failure mode: metadata_only with bounded recovery ending in paywalled_or_restricted or nonmatching candidates. Exact-work recovery attempts used the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus Kirsch Martinelli PDF, and the source volume/pages. The inspected exact-title ResearchGate candidate did not provide readable full text; catalog, sales, and library pages for the volume were metadata only; search results for other random Schrödinger papers were rejected as different works.

Skipped document mapping because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was resolved. Resolver metadata, abstracts, catalog pages, and search snippets are not acceptable technical sources for extraction.
Source adequacy gate failed: the visible sources recovered in the bounded pass did not contain the technical problem statements from the target work, so no questions were extracted.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3935567.json and outputs/latest.json.
